Dear Chemists,

We’re thrilled to bring you a fresh update to enhance your journey in Potion Permit!

Here’s a rundown of what’s new, improved, and fixed in this patch:

PC version 1.5:
[list]
[*] Fixed missing activation trigger on some Side Events.
[*] Adjusted excluded event list for player's progression.
[*] Fixed Blue Sea Cucumber key item name
[*] Fixed Leano FP2 & 3 activation time
[*] Fixed HP bar UI visual when upgrading health
[*] Adjusted character position in Side Event Meditate
[*] Adjusted Noxe events trigger requirement
[*] Fixed lens (magnifier) disappearing during diagnosis
[*] Fixed potions in drop box disappearing & money earned from drop box sales disappear the next day after reloading save file
[*] Fixed time trigger on Side Event Lost and Found
[*] Event Konjac time trigger adjustment
[*] Fixed a typo in Opalheart's first friendship event
[*] Event New Disease 3 activation time delayed (from 1 to 2 days)
[*] Fixed male main character hair color glitch
[*] Adjusted Ending event trigger requirements
[*] Fixed grammatical issue in High Score side event
[*] Fixed dialog sequence in Mercy's first friendship event
[*] Fixed Reyner's seating location in Tavern
[*] Adjusted Olive FP1 trigger activation area
[*] Disabling NPC Background in Lost and Found event
[*] Fixed an issue where a warning didn't show up correctly if a related character isn't available to trigger a quest.
[*] Fixed Dean's Concern Side Quest title
[*] Fixed a minor cauldron UI issue
[*] Fixed Derrek's first story activation time
[*] Fixed photo album page not syncing on closing and re-opening
[*] Fixed cannot use mouse on the confession prompt
[*] Fixed user interface shifting positions within several in-game objects
[/list]


We hope these changes make your experience even more magical and engaging. Thank you for your ongoing support, feedback, and passion for Potion Permit.

As always, keep sharing your thoughts and discoveries!

Happy brewing!

PQube

notes.title: Nominate Potion Permit for Steam's Labour of Love Award!
notes.content:
Hey Potion Brewers, 

We are thrilled to announce that you can now nominate Potion Permit for Steam's Labour of Love Award. 

We're immensely proud of the journey we've taken together since the game's launch, doing our best to update and improve the game, providing you with a richer experience. From cute mini-games to new datable characters and a plethora of exciting features, we've poured our hearts and souls into Potion Permit.


[h2]Added datable characters[/h2]
One of our most exciting updates to Potion Permit has been the introduction of new romanceable characters, Helene and Victor. These unique individuals bring their own captivating stories and personalities to the Moonbury community, offering even more depth to your journey as you navigate the complexities of modern alchemy, relationships, and adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/e897e350b13cc99f5679ba572264e8bf99667a66.gif[/img]


[h2]New mini games[/h2]
One of our new mini-games allows you to join your faithful companion in a mushroom munching competition, where you must guide your loyal canine to devour delicious mushrooms while skillfully avoiding treacherous rocks. These engaging mini-games not only offer fun and challenges but also provide an opportunity to bond with your trusty companion, making your time in Moonbury even more delightful and memorable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/c651eb339e3eb0c904b83ee5b94d5b52410fcfa7.gif[/img]


[h2]Grow box[/h2]
While playing through a new tutorial, you'll be introduced to the Grow Box, a new object which will allow you to plant and grow your own material instead of having to forage it yourself!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/9da95693c53bec337f13f6662fbea42db632560e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2 New Feature Added: Introducing 'Grow Box'
notes.content:
Hey Chemists! 

We come to you with exciting news! After implementing Japanese a couple of months ago, we have been brewing another update which is finally ready to be shared! We have added a new feature to the game! 🥳 

While playing through a new tutorial, you'll be introduced to the Grow Box, a new object which will allow you to plant and grow your own material instead of having to forage it yourself. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/9da95693c53bec337f13f6662fbea42db632560e.gif[/img]

Don't worry, our lovely townsfolk will give you the full rundown of how exactly this awesome new feature works and how to get your hands on the Grow Box and the seeds to make it work! 

[i]See below for the full list of features and fixes coming with the new update: [/i]

[u][b]Version 1.14[/b][/u]

NEW FEATURES 
[list]
[*] Added Grow Box feature 
[*] Added Ranger Post tutorial & event 
[/list]
FIXES
[list]
[*] Fishing bar progress requirements adjustment
[*] Furniture pricing adjustment
[*] Fixed minor bug on world map
[*] Fixed fish weight display
[*] Fixed Godspeed Game's logo display within credits
[*] Fixed Olive's schedule
[/list]

We hope you have the best time trying out our new feature and we can't wait to hear what you think!

Happy growing, Chemists! 🌱

notes.title: Potion Permit Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello Chemists! 

Thank you so much for your support and feedback this past year, we could not be happier with the love and passion you have shown and shared with us and all the residents of Moonbury.

Now, because it's the festive season, we come to you with a little surprise :present:
We are excited to share with you Potion Permit's roadmap for 2023!

There will be [b]four major updates[/b] planned throughout the year, and here's a taste of what's to come:
[list]
[*] Hotly requested, [b]new romance-able characters[/b] are on their way
[*] We'll be adding [b]additional languages[/b]
[*] There will be a [b]new mechanic[/b] and some [b]system changes[/b] to improve quality of life
[*] [b]New quests and arcade mini-games[/b] will also be added
[*] You'll be greeted in-game with a [b]new opening cinematic[/b]
[/list]
We hope you like what's coming to you this upcoming year and can't wait to hear what you think!

Happy Holidays and Happy New Year, Chemists! 🎉

notes.title: Cure ailments with alchemy in Stardew-like town sim Potion Permit
notes.content: Begone overgrown family farms, dilapidated crafting setups, and shops tragically behind on their loans. In crafting and town sim Potion Permit it's the citizens who need shoring up (and, yes, your lab too). These poor folks have a fever and the only prescription is, well, you. As the most accomplished chemist around, the town of Moonbury has summoned you to diagnose the mayor's daughter and brew up cures for everyone else in town during your stay... Read more.

notes.title: Potion Permit Announced for 2021!
notes.content:
Announced for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, and PC on Steam!

Today, PQube and developer MassHive Media are excited to announce Potion Permit for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, and PC on Steam! More news here: [url=https://pqube.co.uk/potion-permit/]https://pqube.co.uk/potion-permit/[/url]

When a devastating illness hits the village of Moonbury, the Medical Association decides to send their most potent chemist: you! Diagnose symptoms, gather ingredients, brew potions, and cure ailments in this open-ended sim RPG, available next year!

Have a look at the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3WvP403k63A&ab_channel=PQubeGames]Announcement Trailer[/url] we brewed up!

The town of Moonbury has always been wary of the advances of the outside world, preferring to rely on their traditional methods of healing. Until one day, when the Mayor’s daughter falls ill and the local Witch Doctor can do nothing to help her, they are forced to look outside their small community for help.

The Medical Association decides to send their most accomplished Chemist – you – to help cure the Mayor’s daughter, but also to convince the residents of Moonbury of the wonders of modern Alchemy!

This is how Potion Permit plays:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/c891fa13299b3a64a44d5c472b6744de513c1344.png[/img]

[b]🤒 1. Receive Requests from Residents. 🤒[/b]

The inhabitants of Moonbury will occasionally fall ill and call for you aid. Keep the town’s infrastructure in tact by curing them in a timely manner, so they can get back to their everyday lives!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/1c429ff1ba9749efde00b4d2f653a6e6304478af.png[/img]

[b]🥼 2. Diagnose Symptoms to decide which Cure to craft. 🥼[/b]

Hmm… a low heart rate and bloated liver. Dander Sneezer, perhaps? No, these are sure signs of Sticky Sweat. This patient has been consuming too much gelatin! Easily remedied, you’ll just need to craft some Jelly Remover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/5d0c5e019547816bc3d8172339b12251c6c71da0.png[/img]

[b]🌿 3. Collect the right Ingredients… 🌿[/b]

… by gathering them.

Search for the required ingredients in the surrounding environment – but watch out for changing weather conditions: Some areas are known to experience dense fog, droughts or even strong blizzards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/7dac25ef24ba42b4172a0715eef8fd35d2b0fa0d.png[/img]

… by hunting Monsters.

Sometimes you will need to turn your trusty tools into weapons and collect them from monsters prowling the nearby wilderness. Combat in real-time and various concoctions to buff yourself or inflict status ailments on your adversaries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/d850d456d9c2eae5c20a2610eada37586e91e68c.gif[/img]

[b]⚗️ 4. Brew Remedies in your Cauldron. ⚗️[/b]

The ingredients you gather can be mixed in your cauldron to brew medicine, vitamins and more. As you become more experienced, higher-level recipes will become available, requiring more ingredients and bestowing stronger effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/b01395698cf297fe8a6c7ce6529a477b9ad1aa12.gif[/img]

[b]🏘️ 5. Build Relationships and… 💜[/b]

… find Romance.

It’ll take a little while, but your patients will be much better thanks to your efforts and open up to you a little more. You may even find yourself growing particularly close to certain bachelors or bachelorettes, regardless of your own gender.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/1b4485166c4525f4d05e04d0f91e519d8413a56e.png[/img]

… Upgrade the Town.

As your approval with the townsfolk grows, you’ll be able to upgrade public buildings and expand the explorable areas around town. You may even be able to design your own home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/8efb461a62f83a669f4c79e9eeeb16381c96e7c1.png[/img]

Potion Permit is coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, and PC on Steam next year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38761022/f0f9ce80f9defb8c012bf617aa330a0d5aa0cacc.gif[/img]

Check out #PotionPermit and @PotionPermit on Twitter!

For more information and the latest news about PQube, follow us on Twitter, Facebook, Twitch, Instagram and our official website: http://pqube.co.uk/
